show.description: Villain Buaa Ka Khooni Khel is a powerful crime drama about loyalty, betrayal, and redemption. Raghav, once the most feared gangster of Mumbai, decides to leave the underworld after a tragic loss. But as rivals close in, allies turn traitors, and his own brother rises against him, Raghav must fight one last bloody battle—between the man he was and the man he wants to be.
